lastCompletedStory.title: Change combineStreams to a single object param, update 4 call sites and 4 unit tests

nextStoryContext: combineStreams(src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts) now takes a single object param `{ stdout: string; stderr: string }` instead of two bare strings; all 4 failing-step call sites (checkout, pull, typecheck, tests) pass the whole spawn-result object with no member access. PlanPreflightSpawnFn's return type is unchanged (stderr still required). clean-tree step untouched (still routes status.stdout.trim() directly, not through combineStreams). Test file's combineStreams describe block updated to object-argument form with same 4 cases (stderr-first, stdout-only, stderr-only, both-empty). This is a sidecar-executed file (wired via preflightFn in src/commands/sidecar.ts), so a running sidecar only picks up this change after a coherence rebuild.
